title: Artificial consciousness may be possible in principle but very demanding

statements.text: Consciousness might be implementable in principle, but it may need a computational specificity beyond present and perhaps future AI systems. The authors do not claim that consciousness cannot be captured in software at all.

sources.quote: consciousness might be implementable in principle, but it might require a level of computational specificity that is beyond the present-day
